query: What is the validity of an Excavation Permit?

result.answer: The validity of an Excavation Permit is not explicitly stated in the provided sources [S1] and [S2]. However, the context suggests that the permit is required prior to the commencement of excavation and construction [S1]. The permit may be issued while the application for a Building Permit is still being processed [S2]. For specific information about the permit's validity period, please refer to the detailed rules and regulations related to the Excavation Permit, which may not be included in the provided sources. [S1, S2]

query: Gaano katagal valid ang Excavation Permit?

result.answer: Ang Excavation Permit ay walang nakitang specific na mga pagkakaroon ng expiration date sa mga nakalaman sa Citizens' Charter. Ngunit, ang Excavation Permit ay maaaring maging valid lamang habang hindi pa tapos ang pag-proseso ng Building Permit. Ang Excavation Permit na ito ay maaaring ibigay ng Building Official habang may verification, inspection, at review pa lamang ng Line at Grade Section ng Inspection at Enforcement Division ([S1]). Sa iba't-ibang pagkakataon, ang Excavation Permit ay kailangan bago mag-commencement ng excavation at construction ([S2]). Ang Excavation Permit na ito ay maaaring maging valid lamang habang hindi pa tapos ang pag-proseso ng Building Permit, at maaaring maging ibinigay ng Building Official habang may Ground Preparation at Excavation Fee pa lamang ([S3]).
